# Stakich Websites

> Stakich Websites (https://stakichwebsites.com) builds and maintains websites for small businesses. Owner: Jeremy Stakich, based in Tennessee, serving businesses anywhere in the United States. Websites are typically live in 1–2 weeks. No contract. The client does not have to build, host, or maintain anything.

## Pricing

- Starter: $499 setup + $49/month. Up to 5 pages, mobile-friendly, tap to call or text, quote form, hosting, HTTPS and security, built to show up in Google search, 2 small updates each month.
- Growth: $899 setup + $79/month. Everything in Starter, up to 8 pages, 1 blog post written each month, social-ready blog posts, Google reviews section, share buttons.
- Pro: $1,499 setup + $129/month. Everything in Growth, up to 12 pages, online booking/menu/quote tools, 2 blog posts each month, priority same-day updates.
